meta.description: Gives every vertex of a mesh a color, like the plates of lamellae or the skin of membrane. Nothing else of the mesh changes. The surface of hyphae_to_mesh takes its colors from set_color instead.

mesh.label: Mesh
mesh.description: The mesh to color all over

color.description: The color of the mesh, set here or from a color node like mix_color to let it follow time. join_meshes keeps it and the viewer shows it
